verdict.rationale: Clerky publishes a remote MCP server (https://mcp.clerky.com/mcp) that works with Claude and ChatGPT, so users can query Clerky through natural language in those assistants. A live probe confirms the server exists behind OAuth, but it notes the tools are read-only and team-scoped, so natural-language operation is limited to viewing data rather than taking actions. missing for 10: write/action-capable natural-language tools (e.g., creating or signing document sets via chat), a native in-product natural-language interface, detailed documentation of the available tools, independent hands-on corroboration.
